title: RateDisciplinePolicy v1 — per-node rate and size discipline as data: one sliding window (window_seconds) in which each sender may have admitted at most max_messages_per_window messages in total, at most max_gossip_per_window of them gossip, at most max_task_per_window of them tasks, and at most max_bytes_per_window admitted bytes in total; no single message larger than max_message_bytes is ever admitted (oversized_allowed is always false); a sender that exceeds a quota is throttled by its peers for throttle_cooldown_seconds (throttle_on_quota is always true) — a policy naming weaker discipline fails validation (Y-060)
